summaries: Reject architecture stamps outside declared affected component claims before sealing records, matching publication validation.
Recognize nested packaged autopilot writers against the package-root manifest while retaining direct-command and content-integrity guards.
Allow intact approved backlogs with legacy scenario-level prose to open a repair revision while keeping validation and approval strict.

Add process switch source_rebind: a backlog revision that only rebinds its sources reviews only the epics an owner-approved, Git-replayed receipt names as impacted, a Delivery keeps its execution approval across that receipt, and Experience source impact covers Solution and Design System revisions.
Run compiler, configuration and hook rule matrices in process locally while preserving full remote integration coverage.
Name repository-relative paths in Delivery closure-check findings instead of paths inside the deleted disposable worktree.

Report a Delivery complete only from a read-only closure audit, add an opt-in pull request closure check and a read-only repository protection report, and state that no delegation or autopilot grant waives closure.

Target each Delivery at the branch its record names instead of the remote's default branch, so a Delivery on another branch reserves, merges and audits as closed without a manual origin/HEAD change; open Deliveries share one target branch, and a new Delivery defaults to the remote's default branch.
Bound package PR review and fix verification to local targets, with full-suite reproduction reserved for existing CI failures.
Lead maintainer explanations with a plain one-sentence problem statement.
Restore bounded project-context reading with complete scope, verified continuation and frozen evidence obligations.

Let an active Item's writer start a path its plan revision adds under a provisional claim, behind process switch provisional_claims, and take an implementer's write scope from the published Item record.
Preserve verification command outputs across attempts and accept equivalent Windows runtime path spellings without relaxing cache containment.
Allow an approved, unpublished execution plan to resume Delivery reservation while retaining all source, Fence and ref checks.
Replace the vault JSON cache with a checkout-local SQLite and FTS5 index while preserving bounded source reading and approval bindings.
Add opt-in, owner-approved Test Plan level schema receipts with deterministic replay and compatibility for already approved Delivery source pins.
